observations.text: Just Do It. The new Pegasus 41 is here. Run your run.
Billboard: a single white swoosh on black, no words. Below it, a runner mid-stride at dawn.
Impossible Is Nothing. Meet the Predator Elite. Three stripes, one goal.
Instagram caption: three stripes on the pitch, three points on the table. #adidasfootball
Don't buy this jacket unless you need it. If you do, we'll repair it for life. Worn Wear.
The Align pant, now in 12 new colours. Buttery soft. Made for the mat and everything after.
iPhone 17 Pro. Titanium. Shot on iPhone. Available Friday.
TV spot: a single laptop on a white table rotates slowly; the only text is 'Think different.'
Galaxy Z Fold7. Unfold your world. Pre-order now and get free Galaxy Buds.
Open Happiness. Ice-cold, in the classic red can. Share a Coke with Sam.
Creative: two polar bears clinking glass bottles of cola under the northern lights.
ba da ba ba ba, I'm lovin' it. Two Big Macs for $6 this week only.
Billboard: golden arches at night with the words 'Open late.' No other copy.
The Pumpkin Spice Latte is back. Order ahead in the app and skip the line.
Creative: a green siren logo on a white cup, steam rising, 'Your fall ritual.'
Red Bull gives you wings. Watch the cliff-diving finals live this Saturday.
Model Y, now from $37,990. Zero emissions. Supercharging included for 12 months.
Let's Go Places. The 2026 Corolla Hybrid, 50 mpg combined. Now at your local dealer.
BILLY bookcase, $59. Flat-pack it, build it, fill it. Meatballs in the restaurant while you decide.
Creative: a tiny blue-and-yellow store bag holds an entire living room; tagline 'It fits.'
Your 2026 Wrapped is ready. See your top songs. Premium is $0 for 3 months.
Tudum. The final season drops October 3. Only on the service with the red N.
Instagram caption: the owl noticed you missed your lesson. 5 minutes a day keeps the streak alive.
Belong Anywhere. Book a treehouse, a lighthouse, or a room in someone's home this weekend.
Prime Day starts Tuesday. Two days of deals, one-day delivery, and the smile arrow on every box.
The Bike+ with auto-resistance. Live classes every hour. Your instructor is waiting.
Look at your man, now back to me. Sadly, he isn't me. But he could smell like me. Body wash, on sale.
Creative: a runner ties her laces; close-up on a swoosh; text 'Your only competition is yesterday.'
Creative: a red can sweats on a picnic table; text 'Taste the Feeling.'
A green owl in a party hat: 'Your 100-day streak is one lesson away.'
Creative: a treadmill in a sunlit apartment, an instructor on screen shouting encouragement. 'Bring the studio home.'
Creative: a foldable phone opens like a book to show two apps side by side. 'Two screens. One device.'
Reuters: Tesla recalls 120,000 vehicles over a seatbelt warning defect, regulator says.
Tweet: the rain finally stopped in Portland, going for a walk before it starts again.
Recipe: whisk two eggs with a pinch of salt, fold in chives, cook on low heat for three minutes.
Support ticket: my Spotify app crashes every time I open the search tab on Android.
Public notice: wildfire smoke advisory in effect until Thursday; limit outdoor exercise.
Job posting: senior data engineer, remote, Python and dbt required, salary range posted.
Abstract: we study the effect of caffeine on reaction time in 40 adults over two weeks.
Text from a friend: running late, order me whatever you're having at the coffee place.
